title: Information about the bundled simdutf library — zuutf_info
text: simdutf picks advanced kernel processor supports first time function needs one: x86-64 "icelake" (AVX-512), "haswell" (AVX2) "westmere" (SSE4.2), ARM64 "arm64" (NEON), "fallback", plain C++, everywhere. Setting environment variable SIMDUTF_FORCE_IMPLEMENTATION kernel name R starts makes simdutf use kernel instead; unknown name, one processor run, gives "unsupported", every function fails.
